description: A WTRP token EOW in a MANAGEMENT message to this node draws WARNING reason 3 and no UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR; in a type 7 it is ignored and the data delivered; the analysis reports WTRP in use.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). At 2000, from 0.0.1.3 to 0.0.1.2, address size 4, EOT 10 (end 7000), both with EOW 0xD05, the WTRP token (EOW type 13, C-0411; Ed4 L p.L-17): a MANAGEMENT D_PDU (VALID MESSAGE 1, ACK 0, frame ID 9) and a single-segment type 7 (C_PDU ID 0, reception window 0, DATA C_PDU holding a DATA S_PDU priority 0, SAP 9 to SAP 5, no TTD, U_PDU pong). The token is a known EOW for a MAC protocol this node does not run, so the MANAGEMENT message is unexpected: acknowledged (C-0296) and WARNING reason 3, RECEIVED FRAME TYPE 6 (J-0037, J-0038, J-0070, J-0081), with no UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR, since EOW 13 is known and Annex C keeps it from the state machine when WTRP is not in use (C.7.5.1, p.C-110; J-0070, J-0081). In the type 7 the token is ignored and the data delivered normally (J-0070, C-0585, B-0298): S_UNIDATA_INDICATION to conn 1, priority 0, SAP 5, destination 0.0.1.2, tx mode 2, source SAP 9, source 0.0.1.3, U_PDU pong (A-0233). At the burst end 3000 the analysis takes the token as WTRP evidence and reports WTRP in use by 0.0.1.3, finding 1 (J-0070, J-0051). Report: S_MANAGEMENT_MSG_INDICATION (type 19) to every bound client, MSG TYPE 1, 9-byte MSG BODY: finding code, the node (4 bytes), the addressee of the WARNING behind it or 0 (4 bytes), addresses 28-bit most significant first (J-0082). csma.vdcd_end 4000; at 7000 LBT rule 1 (all addressed only to this node), CONT_WAIT 45000; at 52000 the acknowledgement (type 6, ACK 1, VALID MESSAGE 0, frame ID 9, address size 3, EOW 0, EMPTY: nothing owed) then the WARNING, EOT 10 each (one block, duration 5550).
